data.one_liner: A Cupertino pie-style circular progress indicator widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable, lightweight Cupertino pie-style circular progress indicator that can be used as a drop-in replacement for CircularProgressIndicator.
use_when: You want a Cupertino pie-style loading or progress indicator.
You need a drop-in replacement for CircularProgressIndicator with enhanced visual appeal.
avoid_when: You require a complex chart or graph implementation.
You are using a completely non-Cupertino design system and prefer strict Material styling.
strengths: Highly customizable size, stroke, and colors.
Includes accessibility support via semantics labels and values.
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific progress indicator style.
